calls.title: Takkt & Growthbook POC Scoping
calls.summary: The team is launching initial experiments on the product detail page (PDP) using three distinct feature zones controlled by JSON schemas for safe feature toggling and metrics tracking. The complexity of the PDP requires careful management to avoid issues seen with previous tools. Plans to launch the first AB test this week include parallel evaluation of a Visual Editor, which faces challenges for non-technical users due to technical limitations. Emphasis is placed on security with peer-reviewed changes before publishing. A structured four-week POC plan aims to demonstrate rapid setup and reliable outcomes while ensuring that integration with React components maintains stability and minimizes DOM manipulation risks.
calls.keywords: POC, Growthbook, Visual Editor, React Integration, Experiment Zones, Approval Workflow

calls.title: Takkt & Growthbook Discussion
calls.summary: The meeting focused on exploring the necessity for a single experimentation tool to drive e-commerce growth by increasing testing speed and optimizing conversion rates. Key goals include enhancing trading and personalization capabilities while addressing the limitations of current multiple tools. The team emphasized the importance of core KPIs such as revenue per visitor and conversion rates, and discussed the limited number of users managing experiments. A proof of concept for GrowthBook was highlighted, assessing its integration with React and server-side rendering. The enterprise model's pricing, set between $30,000 and $50,000, was also noted, with an aim for a decision within two to three months. Ultimately, the team seeks to reduce the time to launch experiments, aiming to decrease lead time from five days to three hours.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Experimentation, E-commerce, Feature Flagging, Data Warehouse Integration, A/B Testing
